{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Tumor imaging at screening only",
      "quote": "Tumor imaging (including brain imaging) | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "Tumor imaging is only scheduled at screening, with no on-treatment or end-of-treatment assessments. This is insufficient for evaluating efficacy and disease progression.",
      "fix": "Add tumor imaging at specified intervals (e.g., every 6-8 weeks) and at end of treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Coagulation only at screening and EOT",
      "quote": "Coagulation: PT, INR, and aPTT | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Coagulation is only measured at screening and end of treatment, but not during treatment cycles. This may miss treatment-induced coagulopathies.",
      "fix": "Include coagulation assessments at least once per cycle or as clinically indicated."
    },
    {
      "title": "Urinalysis only at screening, C1D1, and EOT",
      "quote": "Urinalysis | X | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Urinalysis is not performed during most treatment cycles, which may miss renal toxicity or urinary tract issues.",
      "fix": "Add urinalysis at regular intervals (e.g., every cycle or every other cycle)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Screening window too long",
      "quote": "Screening Days -28 to -1 (Day -28)",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "A 28-day screening window is long and may delay treatment initiation, increasing patient burden and risk of disease progression.",
      "fix": "Consider shortening the screening window to 21 days or less."
    },
    {
      "title": "EOT visit window too wide",
      "quote": "Discon. Visit (EOT) Within 14 Days after Final Dose",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "A 14-day window for the end-of-treatment visit is wide and may lead to variability in safety assessments.",
      "fix": "Narrow the window to 7 days or specify a target visit date."
    },
    {
      "title": "Safety follow-up at 30 days may be too early",
      "quote": "Safety Follow-Up Approx. 30 Days after Final Dose",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "advisory",
      "explanation": "30 days may be insufficient to capture late-onset toxicities or AEs related to the investigational product.",
      "fix": "Consider extending safety follow-up to 60 or 90 days, or until resolution of AEs."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECOG PS at every visit may be burdensome",
      "quote": "ECOG Performance Status | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Assessing ECOG PS at every visit is frequent and may be unnecessary; it could be done less often to reduce burden.",
      "fix": "Consider assessing ECOG PS at screening, each cycle start, and EOT only."
    },
    {
      "title": "Pregnancy test at every visit may be excessive",
      "quote": "Serum or urine pregnancy test | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Pregnancy testing at every visit is frequent and may be unnecessary for postmenopausal or surgically sterile participants.",
      "fix": "Limit pregnancy testing to screening, monthly, and at EOT, or based on risk."
    }
  ]
}
